title: SSC Stenographer 2026 - 731 Posts, Fee Payment Deadline Today May 16, Don't Miss
author: Ash K.
summary: SSC Stenographer Grade C and D recruitment 2026 fee payment deadline is today, May 16. Application closed May 15 but fee can be paid until May 16. Total 731 posts. 12th pass eligible. Exam in August-September 2026.
body: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Stenographer Grade C and D Examination 2026 fee payment deadline is today - May 16, 2026. If you've submitted your application but haven't paid the fee yet, do it immediately.

DetailInformation
Total Posts731 (Grade C + Grade D)
Application ClosedMay 15, 2026 (11 PM)
Fee Payment DeadlineMay 16, 2026 (TODAY)
Eligibility12th pass from recognized board
Age - Grade C18-30 years
Age - Grade D18-27 years
Application Fee₹100 (Gen/OBC), Free for SC/ST/PwBD/Women
Stenography SpeedGrade C: 100 WPM | Grade D: 80 WPM
Exam TypeCBT + Skill Test (Stenography)
Negative Marking0.25 marks per wrong answer
Expected Exam DateAugust-September 2026

Exam pattern: Computer Based Test with 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Three sections - General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 Qs), General Awareness (50 Qs), English Language & Comprehension (100 Qs). Sectional timing: 30 minutes each for Section I and II, 60 minutes for Section III. Negative marking of 0.25 per wrong answer.

After CBT: Candidates who qualify the CBT are called for the Skill Test in Stenography. Grade C requires dictation at 100 WPM and transcription in 40 minutes (English) or 55 minutes (Hindi). Grade D requires 80 WPM dictation with same transcription times.

Grade C vs Grade D: Grade C is a Group B (Non-Gazetted) post with higher pay scale (₹44,900-1,42,400 Level 6). Grade D is a Group C post (₹25,500-81,100 Level 4). Grade C requires stenography at 100 WPM while Grade D needs 80 WPM.

Career growth: SSC Stenographer is one of the fastest career growth tracks in government. Grade D stenographers can be promoted to Personal Assistant and eventually to Principal Private Secretary. Grade C offers even faster promotion to Section Officer level.
For SSC exam preparation, check our SSC CGL complete guide. For comparison with other government exams, see our Bank PO vs SSC CGL comparison.

faqs.question: When is the fee payment deadline for SSC Stenographer 2026?
faqs.answer: The fee payment deadline is May 16, 2026. Application submission closed on May 15 but fee can still be paid on May 16.

faqs.question: What is the qualification for SSC Stenographer 2026?
faqs.answer: 12th pass (or equivalent) from a recognized Board or University. No graduation required.

faqs.question: What is the difference between SSC Steno Grade C and Grade D?
faqs.answer: Grade C is Group B (Non-Gazetted) with Level 6 pay (₹44,900-1,42,400) and requires 100 WPM stenography. Grade D is Group C with Level 4 pay (₹25,500-81,100) and requires 80 WPM.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in SSC Stenographer exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer in the CBT.

faqs.question: When is the SSC Stenographer 2026 exam date?
faqs.answer: The exam is expected in August-September 2026. Exact dates will be notified on ssc.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is the SSC Stenographer fee refundable?
faqs.answer: No. The application fee of ₹100 for General/OBC is non-refundable. SC/ST/PwBD candidates and women are exempt from the fee.

callout.heading: Fee Deadline TODAY
callout.content: If you've submitted your SSC Stenographer application but haven't paid the ₹100 fee, pay it NOW. The fee payment window closes today, May 16, 2026. Without fee payment, your application will be rejected.
